statement: A government in a top-3 compute jurisdiction takes equity, a golden share or a formal priority-access security partnership with a top-5 frontier developer (by 2027-12-31)
status_at_phase_end: Not met in 2024. Bloc A: first formal government-developer agreements (safety institute pre- and post-release model access with two leading developers, Aug 2024), a national-security memorandum making the institute the government's primary contact with frontier developers (Oct 2024), and leading developers opening models to defence and intelligence users via contractors (Nov 2024). These are testing/procurement relationships with no equity, golden share or priority-access terms. Bloc B: city and national state funds took repeated minority stakes in a leading domestic developer (Jan, Sept, Dec 2024), but it was not a global top-5 frontier developer.

items.summary: A leading Bloc B developer announced a capital injection from state-run AI-focused funds, including a city-government AI fund set up in January 2024 as part of a ~CNY 50bn fund family.
items.detail: Zhipu AI, investment from the Bloc B AI Industry Investment Fund and other state-run funds (TechNode 2024-03-15 citing Caixin). Amount undisclosed. Minority stake; Zhipu not a global top-5 frontier developer.

items.summary: A top-5 Bloc A frontier developer appointed a former head of its jurisdiction's signals-intelligence agency to its board and safety committee - a security-state link, but not a government stake or partnership.
items.detail: OpenAI board appointment of retired Gen. Paul Nakasone (former NSA director), announced 2024-06-13. Not verified via web_extract this run.

items.summary: Bloc A's AI safety institute signed first-of-their-kind agreements with two top-5 frontier developers giving it access to major new models before and after public release, for joint capability and risk evaluation. A formal government-developer partnership, but testing-only - no priority access, equity or control terms.
items.detail: NIST press release 'Bloc A. AI Safety Institute Signs Agreements Regarding AI Safety Research, Testing and Evaluation With Anthropic and OpenAI' (2024-08-29), verified via search snippet of nist.gov. MOUs; joint Bloc A/Bloc G pre-deployment tests published Nov-Dec 2024.

items.summary: A city-government science-park fund led a further multi-billion-yuan round in the same Bloc B developer (~CNY 20bn valuation); its shareholders already included a social-security-fund vehicle and a city AI fund.
items.detail: Zhipu AI round led by state-backed Bloc B Zhongguancun Science City (Yicai 2024-09-06). Earlier backers: Bloc B AI Industry Investment Fund, National Social Security Fund's Zhongguancun Independent Innovation Fund.

items.summary: Bloc A's first national-security memorandum on AI named the safety institute as the government's primary point of contact with frontier developers, ordered voluntary pre-deployment testing of at least two frontier models within 180 days plus classified testing by security agencies, and directed agencies to act 'in partnership with industry'. Framework for security partnership, without ownership or priority-access terms.
items.detail: White House 'Memorandum on Advancing the Bloc A' Leadership in Artificial Intelligence...' (NSM-25), 2024-10-24, with classified annex. Summaries: Covington, Mayer Brown, RAND (verified via search snippets).

items.summary: A Bloc A developer of leading open-weight models made them available to its government's defence and national-security agencies and contractors, granting exceptions to its own military-use ban.
items.detail: Meta 'Open Source AI Can Help Bloc A Lead in AI and Strengthen Global Security' (2024-11-04). Not verified via web_extract; confirmed indirectly by TechCrunch/The Register coverage of 2024-11-07.

items.summary: A top-5 Bloc A frontier developer, a defence-software contractor and a cloud provider announced access for Bloc A intelligence and defence agencies to the developer's models in a Secret-level accredited environment. Commercial channel, not a government stake or priority-access deal.
items.detail: Anthropic-Palantir-AWS partnership, Business Wire 2024-11-07 (verified via search snippet): Claude 3/3.5 in Palantir AIP on IL6 environment.

items.summary: The same Bloc B developer closed a CNY 3bn round with state-backed institutions among strategic investors - its third state-involved round of 2024.
items.detail: Zhipu AI CNY 3bn (~$412M) round, Yicai 2024-12-18. Earlier 2024: ~$400M round with a Gulf state-oil venture fund (May-June).
